caveats:
This dataset was corrected on 3 August 2021.  Data available previously placed administrative level 3 feature "Paillaco" [now CL14107] incorrectly in administrative level 2 feature "Ranco", instead of the correct administrative level 2 feature "Valdivia" [CL141].

The source shapefiles included an overlapping polygon ‘Zona sin demarcar’ (‘Unmarked area’) polygon straddling the Argentinian border that polygon that has been removed.

These shapefiles contain several hundred unresolved topology errors that cause minor errors in the administrative level tagging of the lines shapefile.  Lines surrounding internal topological gaps may be tagged as shorelines.

P-codes: nan
name: cod-ab-chl
notes:
Chile administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01.  
  
This dataset is structured into 3 levels:  
- Admin 1: 16   
- Admin 2: 56   
- Admin 3: 345   
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 17 February 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 08 October 2021: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 05 September 2018: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 05 September 2018: boundaries created by the source  
  
Contributed by [OCHA Latin America and the Caribbean (ROLAC)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-rolac).  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
